rows.grounds: action noun from kḷp (to fashion, arrange, imagine)
compound with internal sandhi; samyak (proper/correct) + geha (house)

items.question: What characterizes the conceptual fashioning of mark and limb as a form of bondage?
premises: The fashioning of mark and limb is identified as a conceptual construction.
This construction is associated with a proper house.
The construction is characterized as bondage.
items.inference: The conceptual fashioning of mark and limb, situated in the proper house, is defined by the characteristic of bondage.
uncertainties: The precise referents of liṅga and aṅga are unclear without surrounding context.
The meaning of samyaggeha (proper house) is context-dependent and uncertain.
The syntactic role of the compound chain is inferred in the absence of a finite verb.
items.plain_english: The fashioning of mark and limb is characterized as bondage within the proper house.
